basic_profile.bio: A seasoned tech enthusiast in my early 30s, I'm based in Austin, Texas. I have a deep passion for PC building and retro gaming. During weekdays, I work as a software developer, which often bleeds into my weekends as I tinker with code and new tech. I'm single and enjoy the flexibility it gives me to dive into my hobbies. My typical online hours are late evenings after work, when I wind down by engaging with tech communities and catching up on the latest hardware trends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been building PCs since my college days. My expertise comes from both formal education and countless hours of self-directed learning and experimentation. I stay updated by watching tech reviews and following industry news.
